newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba says has experimental high-definition DVD.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba says has experimental high-definition DVD.

text.p: Toshiba Corp said on Tuesday that it has produced an experimental high-definition digital video disc (DVD) system that offers better pictures than existing DVD systems.
The system's data capacity is also about 1.6 times larger than existing DVD systems, Toshiba said in a statement.
It said the combination of increased capacity and the latest image-processing technology allows the system to store and play 133 minutes of high-definition images.
A Toshiba spokesman said, however, that it would be several years at least before the system could be commercialised.
